title: Resolution as Attention for Efficient Agent Memory Perception
abstract: arXiv:2611.24422v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based agents accumulate extensive interaction histories when solving complex, long-horizon tasks, making efficient memory management critical to their performance and scalability. While existing memory management methods primarily focus on what to retain or retrieve, they often overlook how much perceptual detail should be allocated to individual past interactions. We posit that effective agent memory depends not only on the information preserved, but also on the granularity at which each past interaction is perceived. Motivated by this insight, we propose Resolution as Attention (RAA), a memory perception mechanism that uses visual resolution as a means of attention allocation across interaction histories. translated_title: 分辨率即注意力：面向高效智能体记忆感知的方法
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在解决复杂的长期任务时会积累大量的交互历史，这使得高效的记忆管理对其性能和可扩展性至关重要。现有的记忆管理方法主要关注“保留或检索什么内容”，却往往忽视了应为单个过往交互分配多少感知细节。我们认为，有效的智能体记忆不仅取决于所保存的信息本身，还取决于每个过往交互被感知的粒度。基于这一洞察，我们提出了“分辨率即注意力”（RAA）机制，这是一种记忆感知机制，它将视觉分辨率作为跨交互历史进行注意力分配的手段。RAA将过往交互渲染为图像，并在每一步根据其与智能体即将做出的决策的相关性动态调整图像分辨率，从而为关键交互保留细粒度的信息，同时降低次要交互的分辨率以提升效率。
tldr: 提出“分辨率即注意力”（RAA）机制，将过往交互渲染为图像并根据其与未来决策的相关性动态调整分辨率，从而实现对智能体记忆的高效注意力分配。
en_tdlr: Proposes Resolution as Attention (RAA), a memory perception mechanism that renders past interactions as images and dynamically adjusts their resolution based on relevance to upcoming decisions, enabling efficient attention allocation in LLM-based agent memory management.
